analyzed_vuln.description: Heap OOB read in cmap format 6/10 unicode collection: `collect_unicodes()` iterates `i < glyphIdArray.len` and reads `glyphIdArray[i]` without enforcing that `glyphIdArray.len` is consistent with the subtable `length` field. For the PoC, sanitizer accepts/truncates malformed table data, leaving a too-large logical array length relative to actual blob bytes; iteration reaches the end and performs a 2-byte read past the 42-byte allocation (crash seen in BEInt<uint16_t>::operator uint16_t).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer provides a malformed OpenType font with a crafted `cmap` subtable (format 10 path in this crash) where header/length fields cause `ArrayOf<HBGlyphID16, UINT> glyphIdArray` length metadata to exceed available bytes after sanitization/truncation. Data flow: hb-shape-fuzzer input -> face creation/sanitization (`sanitize_blob<OT::cmap>`) -> cmap accelerator -> `hb_face_collect_unicodes()` in test path -> `CmapSubtable::collect_unicodes()` dispatches to format10 trimmed collector -> loop reads beyond heap buffer.
